_metadata.source: Sprint 1 seed data — curated subset of the SAP BAdI Catalog and Cloudification Repository released-BAdI list

levelLegend.A: Released for cloud — public API, stable, recommended
levelLegend.B: Released for on-premise — acceptable for Private Cloud / S/4 on-prem only
levelLegend.C: Not released — classic BAdI, allowed only if no Level A/B alternative exists

badis.name: ME_PROCESS_PO_CUST
badis.description: Customer-specific enhancements during purchase order processing. Released for S/4HANA Cloud and on-premise.
badis.exampleUseCase: Validate PO line items, default supplier-specific fields

badis.name: ME_REQ_POSTED
badis.description: BAdI called after a purchase requisition is posted. Released cloud-ready.

badis.name: BADI_SD_SALES_BASIC
badis.description: Sales document processing — header and item level customer logic. Released cloud-ready.
badis.exampleUseCase: Default sales document fields, custom validations on sales order create/change

badis.name: BADI_SD_SALES_ITEM
badis.description: Item-level enhancements during sales order processing.

badis.name: ATP_CUST_BADI
badis.description: Customer-specific extensions to ATP (Available-to-Promise) checks. Use this BAdI for backorder and ATP enhancements — NOT a USEREXIT_ATP_QUANTITY routine, which does not exist.
badis.exampleUseCase: Influence ATP quantity calculation during backorder processing

badis.name: BADI_SD_BILLING
badis.description: Customer enhancements in billing document processing (header/item).

badis.name: FAGL_DERIVE_SEGMENT
badis.description: Derive segment characteristic in New GL postings. Released cloud-ready.

badis.name: ACC_DOCUMENT
badis.description: BAdI for influencing accounting document creation. Released cloud-ready.

badis.name: AC_DOCUMENT
badis.description: Accounting document influence at posting time. Released cloud-ready.

badis.name: BADI_MATERIAL_CHECK
badis.description: Material master validation BAdI — released cloud-ready.

badis.name: BUPA_FURTHER_CHECKS
badis.description: Business Partner additional validation checks. Released cloud-ready.

badis.name: WORKORDER_UPDATE
badis.description: Production order update BAdI — released for on-premise S/4HANA only.
badis.notes: For S/4HANA Cloud, use the PP RAP Behavior Definition instead.

badis.name: BADI_FDCB_SUBBAS01
badis.description: Enjoy transactions screen subscreen BAdI. Released for on-premise — limited cloud applicability.

badis.name: ME_GUI_PO_CUST
badis.description: PO screen layout BAdI — UI-side enhancement. Released for on-premise; Fiori uses different extension model.

badis.name: BADI_SD_V46H0001
badis.description: Classic SD pricing BAdI — released for on-premise.

badis.name: BADI_GET_ACCOUNT_GROUP
badis.description: Classic BAdI for vendor account group determination — NOT released for cloud. Use ACC_DOCUMENT for cloud-eligible scenarios.

badis.name: MB_DOCUMENT_BADI
badis.description: Material document BAdI — classic, not released for cloud. Prefer MIGO_BADI or material movement RAP behaviors.
badis.alternative: MIGO_BADI (Level B) or RAP behavior /SCMB/I_GoodsMovement (Level A)

badis.name: WORKORDER_GOODSMVT
badis.description: Goods movement during production order confirmation — classic only.

badis.name: USEREXIT_ATP_QUANTITY
badis.description: DOES NOT EXIST. This is a commonly hallucinated name produced by LLMs. The real extension point for ATP customization is the BAdI ATP_CUST_BADI (Level A).

badis.name: BADI_VBAK_CHECK
badis.description: DOES NOT EXIST. Commonly hallucinated BAdI name. Use BADI_SD_SALES_BASIC for sales order header validation.

badis.name: MM_PO_VALIDATE
badis.description: DOES NOT EXIST. Use ME_PROCESS_PO_CUST instead.

badis.name: BADI_FI_POSTING
badis.description: DOES NOT EXIST. Use ACC_DOCUMENT for influencing accounting document postings.

badis.name: BADI_BACKORDER_PROCESS
badis.description: DOES NOT EXIST. For backorder processing, use ATP_CUST_BADI.

badis.name: BADI_PRICING_ENHANCEMENT
badis.description: DOES NOT EXIST. For pricing, use BADI_SD_V46H0001 (Level B, on-prem) or condition technique routines.
